metadata.name: shadowbid
metadata.description: Privacy-preserving blind auction system on Solana with Arcium MPC

instructions.name: cancel_auction
docs: Cancel auction (only if no bids placed)

instructions.name: close_auction
docs: Close auction (manually or via MPC result)

instructions.name: compare_bids
docs: Trigger the winner comparison via Arcium MPC

instructions.name: compare_bids_callback
docs: Callback received from Arcium MPC network with the winner

instructions.name: create_auction
docs: Initialize a new blind auction

instructions.name: place_bid
docs: Place an encrypted bid (bid amount derived from token transfer)

instructions.name: refund_bid
docs: Refund losing bids

instructions.name: settle_auction
docs: Settle winning bid - transfer funds to auction creator

instructions.name: start_auction
docs: Start the auction (move from Pending to Active)

errors.name: InvalidTimeRange
errors.msg: Invalid time range: end time must be after start time

errors.name: StartTimeInPast
errors.msg: Start time cannot be in the past

errors.name: NameTooLong
errors.msg: Item name is too long (max 64 characters)

errors.name: DescriptionTooLong
errors.msg: Item description is too long (max 256 characters)

errors.name: BidBelowReserve
errors.msg: Bid amount is below reserve price

errors.name: CannotCancelWithBids
errors.msg: Cannot cancel auction with active bids

errors.name: InvalidWinningBid
errors.msg: Winning bid account does not match the supplied result

errors.name: ArciumCallbackRequired
errors.msg: Auction must be closed by a verified Arcium callback

errors.name: ClusterNotSet
errors.msg: Arcium MXE account is not assigned to a cluster

errors.name: InvalidCiphertextOffset
errors.msg: Ciphertext chunk offset does not match current ciphertext length

types.name: ClockAccount
docs: An account storing the current network epoch

types.name: ComputationDefinitionAccount
docs: An account representing a [ComputationDefinition] in a MXE.

types.name: ComputationDefinitionMeta
docs: A computation definition for execution in a MXE.

types.name: ComputationSignature
docs: The signature of a computation defined in a [ComputationDefinition].

types.name: Epoch
docs: The network epoch

types.name: MXEAccount
docs: A MPC Execution Environment.

types.name: MxeStatus
docs: The status of an MXE.

types.name: NodeMetadata
docs: location as [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html) country code

types.name: NodeRef
docs: A reference to a node in the cluster.
The offset is to derive the Node Account.
The current_total_rewards is the total rewards the node has received so far in the current
epoch.

types.name: Output
docs: An output of a computation.
We currently don't support encrypted outputs yet since encrypted values are passed via
data objects.

types.name: Parameter
docs: A parameter of a computation.
We differentiate between plaintext and encrypted parameters and data objects.
Plaintext parameters are directly provided as their value.
Encrypted parameters are provided as an offchain reference to the data.
Data objects are provided as a reference to the data object account.

types.name: SetUnset
docs: Utility struct to store a value that needs to be set by a certain number of participants (keys
in our case). Once all participants have set the value, the value is considered set and we only
store it once.
